project.title: Nudibranch
project.content:
A sea slug in bold black linework that comes alive: it floats, its limbs ripple like seaweed, and when you stir too fast it pulls them in and flares into warning colours, then slowly calms down again.

Real nudibranchs warn with colour – often of the poison they take from their food. This field guide follows six species of the invented genus Mikatoa, from the mint drifter to the ink ghost; each is coloured by what it eats, a pastel from this site at rest and a strong warning colour when alarmed. The motion is made in p5.js from the one drawing: every point turns around the body's spine as a wave travels along it, and the limb tips curl. A first version had a small neural network (Python, PyTorch) learn the frames between two hand-drawn poses – it's in the process below.
